name: OmniDoc: Meeting & Class Notes
description:
OmniDoc turns a meeting or a class into one document.

Start a session and take a photo of each slide, handout or whiteboard as it comes up. When you stop, OmniDoc puts every page next to what was said while it was shown, and every point links to its moment and page: tap a link to hear it again.

No meeting to record right now? Tap "Try a sample session" on the Sessions tab to open a finished example. It works offline.

A SESSION, START TO FINISH
• Start a Meeting or a Class from the Sessions tab
• Capture page: the camera opens over the recording, which keeps running
• Pages added later are placed where their content was discussed
• Slide-Synced Notes: every slide with what was said about it, no AI needed
• Not Covered: the handouts nobody talked about, listed separately
• Timeline: tap a page or a line to listen from there
• The recording keeps going with the screen off, in a notification with the running time, Pause, Marker and Stop

ON-DEVICE AI, ON SUPPORTED DEVICES
On supported devices with on-device AI (Gemini Nano), OmniDoc also writes meeting minutes, lecture notes, summaries and action items. Every point cites the time and the page. On other devices, Slide-Synced Notes, transcripts and PDFs work as usual.

TRANSCRIPTS
• Made on your device with Android's speech recognition, in supported languages (a speech pack downloads once per language)
• Timestamps; export as text, SRT or WebVTT subtitles

ALSO IN THE TOOLBOX
• Scan pages with auto capture and cleanup filters; searchable PDFs
• Convert Word, Excel, PowerPoint, text files, photos and web links to PDFs
• PDF tools: mark up, edit text and images, organize pages, fill and sign, merge, compress, protect with a password and print
• Your original is never changed: every edit is saved as a new version
• Export as PDF, Word, Excel, CSV, text or Markdown

RIGHT FROM YOUR HOME SCREEN
• Widgets: Quick Create (Scan, Record and Meeting), Recents (your latest documents) and Recents and Activity (the recording with Stop and documents in progress)
• Quick Settings tiles: Record and Scan
• App shortcuts: touch and hold the OmniDoc icon for Scan to PDF, Record with OmniDoc, Record a meeting and your most recent document
• Long documents keep being made in the background with a progress notification

ON YOUR WEAR OS WATCH
• OmniDoc records on the watch, even without the phone: recordings stay on the watch and move to OmniDoc on your phone when it is connected. With the screen off, a recording icon and the running time stay on the watch face
• Record tile: start a recording; while one runs, its start time and Stop
• Last document tile: your newest document from the phone and its first summary point
• Record complication: REC, or the running time while recording
• Last recording complication: the title and length of your last recording
• Needs OmniDoc on your phone: pausing, marking and stopping a phone recording, the shutter for the OmniDoc camera on the phone, Activity, recent documents and the Last document tile
• No ads on the watch

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Recordings, pages and documents are processed on your devices and stay there. OmniDoc has no account. Please ask before recording other people: the law in some places requires everyone's consent.

FREE, WITH OPTIONAL VIDEOS
OmniDoc is free and shows ads on the phone. Free includes the first 15 minutes of transcription in each session or recording and 3 AI documents. When you reach a limit, you can choose to watch 2 short videos to unlock every Pro feature for 24 hours: whole-session transcripts, unlimited minutes and notes, Word and Excel export, password-protected PDFs, batch conversion and premium templates. There are no ads while you record, scan or edit.

Privacy Policy: https://orlproducts.com/omnidoc-privacy.html
